# Permly — Selective Notification Manager for Android

> Permly lets you silence notifications from specific apps using named profiles (Work, Sleep, Focus, etc.) without enabling full Do Not Disturb. Privacy-first: the app never reads notification content, collects no data, and requires no internet connection.

> License: RSL-1.0 (https://reference.tldr.legal/rsl/)

Permly is a free Android app available on Google Play. It requires Android 8.0 or higher and the Notification Access permission. It intercepts notification metadata (sending app package name) to decide whether to suppress a notification — it never reads notification text or payload. All settings and statistics are stored locally on the device. No analytics, no crash reporting, no third-party SDKs, no internet permission.

Free tier: up to 3 custom profiles, 7-day notification statistics. Pro tier unlocks unlimited profiles and extended statistics. Pro pricing: $1.99/month, $14.99/year ($1.25/month effective, saves 37% vs monthly), or $29.99 one-time lifetime purchase.

## App

- [Permly on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.permly): Download page for the Android app. Free to install; Pro features available as in-app purchases.

## Pages

- [Support & FAQ](https://permly.app/support): Answers common questions — how profiles work, how to fix notifications not being blocked, battery optimisation steps, Free vs Pro feature comparison, and how to contact support (zartofapp@gmail.com).
- [Home](https://permly.app/): Landing page with full feature overview, screenshot gallery, pricing plans, and comparison against full Do Not Disturb solutions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://permly.app/privacy-policy): Full privacy policy. Confirms Permly collects zero personal data. Documents the two system permissions used: Notification Access (to intercept and suppress notifications) and POST_NOTIFICATIONS (Android 13+ service status notification). No internet permission is requested or used.
- [Terms of Service](https://permly.app/terms-of-service): Terms covering app usage, in-app purchases, subscription cancellation, and refund policy.
